svg.title: GreenREFORM-EU - DREAM heritage mark
svg.desc: The next disc in the DREAM model-logo family. Geometry matched to the GronREFORM disc: wordmark block 74 percent of the disc diameter, optically centred, tracking 0.23em. Colour is the model's own deep green.

g.font-family: Bahnschrift Light, Bahnschrift, Eurostile, Aldrich, Segoe UI, Arial, sans-serif
